tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lū hi pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon rtogs thar 'dod 'jug ngogs bde ba'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpa' he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir lū hi ba'i lugs kyi bde mchog mngon rtogs 'dzin 'don du 'jug pa bde bar dgod par bya ste/ de yang skad cig gis rang nyid he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ /rdo rje ni thabs dang dril bu ni shes rab ste/ de gnyis ka'ang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+ṭa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /hūm̐ sems can rmongs dang 'brel ba yi/ /rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa yis/ /rnam thar chos kyi bya ba ste/ spro dang bcas pas rdo rje gzung*/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ne pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta nā da swa bhā we badz+ra satwa hṛd ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las/ yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa grwa gsum du me 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las byung ba'i mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i a dkar bo las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba de'i nang gi shar du oṃ dkar bo las byung ba'i dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/

byang du khaṃ ljang ku las byung ba'i klad pa khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ dmar bo las byung ba'i byang sems dkar bo aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor traṃ ser bo las byung ba'i rak+ta traṃ gis mtshan pa/ /dbus su hūm̐ mthing ga las byung ba'i dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mer laṃ dkar po las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ bden bral du maṃ sngon po las byung ba'i khyi'i sha maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung du paṃ dmar po las byung ba'i glang bo che'i sha paṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du taṃ ljang ku las byung ba'i rta'i sha taṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dbus su baṃ dmar po las byung ba'i mi'i sha baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos pa las me 'bar ba'i drod kyis rdzas rnams yi ge dang bcas pa zhu nas/ nyi ma 'char ga'i mdog ltar dmar ser du gyur/ /de'i steng du hūm̐ dkar bo las byung ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can mgo thur du bltas pa thod par lhung ste zhu bas/ bcud de dag dngul chu'i mdog can bsil bar gyur/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yi ge de nyid kha dog sna tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i steng du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po

lū gsum steng nas steng du gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug cing*/ 'od zer gyis 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo bkug pa rnams kyang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu ba oṃ āḥhūm̐ la thim zhing*/ de sum yang rim gyis zhu ba thod par thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shung+nghaḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog/bdug sbos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so so'i rnam pa can/ byed las dbang bo drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā t+yaṃ= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= oṃ badz+ra dhū pe= oṃ badz+ra dī pe= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe= oṃ badz+ra ne wi te= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ mchod pa byin brlab byas/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ pheṃ/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong klu la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod pa skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las/ bde mchog gi lha yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/

oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsa/ un+ma da/ a pa smā ra/ badz+ra ḍā ka /ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ grih+naṃ tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ mā ma sarba sing+nghi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu ya the baṃ/ ya the ṣ+taṃ/ bhu dza tha/ bi pa*/ /dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sar+b+ba kārta ya/ sad su khaṃ bi shung+ngha ye/ sa ha yi ka bha ban+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gnyis brjod/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ pā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ ne we te/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ swā hā/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong klu la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis mchis pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad ba/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/

/longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /bsrung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig/dus min 'ching dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang 'gegs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/yig brgya brjod la/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /de nas bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa byin brlab sngon 'gro gtor ma'i mchod pa ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchis/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang*/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru kar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi/ lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum rdo rje bsnyems ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas sbras pa/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma pa shri ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ chu lhag ma spy-i gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar/ yi ge brgya ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrig dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng hūm̐ dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas/ sngags phreng hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim pas/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po babs pa yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thon/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs te dag par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā lā ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sing+nghi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wāṃ/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig brjod nas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig/gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/

/thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ / 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rang la thim pas/ rang gi sgo gsum dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed bar gyur/ shī he ru ka /he ni kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur ba'i sems te/ rgyu'i bdag nyid du brtag par bya pas stongs pa'i chos kyi bdag med pa dang*/ ru ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi dra bas bkod pa'i bdag dang bral ba'i gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ ka ni de kho na nyid kyi yul yul can gnyis mi mthun par so sor gnyis su mi gnas pa dang*/ shrī ni yul stong ba nyid ji 'dra ba de bzhin du rjes su zhugs pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes e waṃ gyi don ni/ /stong ba'i ngang las/ skad cig gis rang nyid he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ a ā/ zhes pa nas/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum/ rang gi lte ba'i phyogs su sngags phreng 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa g.yon skor gyis lan gsum du bskor nas gnas pa las/ 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs 'phros pa/ sna bug g.yas nas 'thon te phyir 'phros pas/ bgegs thams cad bsgrad de/ slar byon rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs te/ lte ba'i sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig/sems can thams cad thob zin pa'i bde ba brtan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad yid de bzhin nyid la ro gcig tu gnas par gyur cig /rang gi dpral ba'i dbus su bruṃ dkar bo yongs su gyur pa las/

rnam snang dkar po phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ lte bar aṃ ser po=/ rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mgrin par hrī dmar po=/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po g.yas pad+ma dmar po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rkang ba gnyis phyi long bu'i 'og tu ho ljang ku=/ rdo rje rgyal bo ljang ku g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ snying gar hūm̐ dkar bo= rdo rje sems dpa' dkar bo g.yas thugs kar rdo rje 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ spyi gtsug tu hi nag po= he ru ka nag po g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ mig gnyis su oṃ dkar bo= gti mug rdo rje dkar bo g.yas 'khor lo 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ rna ba gnyis su hūm̐ nag po= zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas thugs kar rdo rje 'dzin cing g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sna bug gnyis su traṃ ser po= ser sna rdo rje ser po g.yas las rol ba dang bcas pas rin po che 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon rol ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ lce'i rtsa bar aṃ dmar po = 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po g.yas rol ba dang bcas pas pad+ma dmar po 'phyar zhing*/ /g.yon rol ba dang bcas bas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dpral bar khaṃ ljang ku= phrag dog rdo rje ljang ku g.yas rol ba dang bcas pas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon rol ba dang bcas pas dril bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ snying gar haṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang phyug rdo rje dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/

g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral ba'i cod pan can phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ lte ba sa la laṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ ltung byed ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ snying ga chu la maṃ nag po= gsod byed ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis= mgrin pa me la paṃ dmar bo ='gugs byed ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis= dpral ba rlung la taṃ ljang ku= gar gyi dbang phyug ma ljang ku zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis= gsang gnas nam mkha'i khams la khaṃ dud kha yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma'i dra ba can dud kha/ rtsa zhal dud kha g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gri gug tshangs mgo lcags kyu/ g.yon thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ pra gṛ ta ri shung+nghaḥ sarba dharmaḥ pra kṛ ta ba ri shung+ngho3haṃ/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ shar du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po/ oṃ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang ku/ oṃ grih+ṇa pa ya grih+ṇa pa ya huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar po/ /oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser bo rnams 'khod par gyur/ sngags de rnams las rang rang gi kha dog can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas/ 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par khyab pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzugs chen po rnams su gyur/ sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/

shar nag/byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi ba/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyis gzhi la thug pa'i bar du khyab par gyur/ ra ba grub pa dang dus mnyam du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer las/ gser gyis gzhi la thug pa'i 'og gi sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer las/ phyi rol tu steng dang logs kun tu khyab par rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba dang*/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur dang*/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re rnams par mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me 'jig dus kyi me lta bus bskor bar gyur/ oṃ me de nī badz+ra bha ba badz+ra ban+dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra prā ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsar hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā a na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ lan gnyis/ shar dang steng du sngags de nyid kha dog nag po gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ kha gdong ma nag mo gnyis/ oṃ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang ku yongs su gyur pa las/ 'ug gdong ma ljang ku/ oṃ grih+ṇa pa ya grih+ṇā pa ya huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ lan gnyis/ nub dang 'og tu sngags de nyid kha dog dmar bo gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ khyi gdong ma dmar mo gnyis/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ lhor sngags de nyid kha dog ser bo yongs su gyur pa las/ phag gdong ma ser mo/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+rā huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ shar lhor sngags de nyid kha dog nag po dang ser bo 'od zer dang bcas pa gnyis 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/

oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇa pa ya grih+ṇa pa ya huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ lho nub tu sngags de nyid kha dog ser bo dang dmar bo 'od zer dang bcas pa gnyis 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ oṃ grih+ṇā pa ya grih+ṇā pa ya huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ nub byang du sngags de nyid kha dog dmar bo dang ljang ku 'od zer dang bcas pa gnyis 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ oṃ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar du sngags de nyid kha dog ljang ku dang dag po 'od zer dang bcas pa gnyis 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can/ g.yas kyi rdo rje tho ba dang*/ g.yon kyis rang 'dra'i phur bu bsnams pa/ de rnams kyis rang 'dra du ma phyogs bcur sbros nas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug ste/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyir rol dang nye bar hūṃ dang hūṃ ring po nag po bcu las grub pa'i khron pa bcur/ so so'i bgegs rnams bcug par gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+tā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dhā ra a dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba duṣ+tā bighan kā ya wak+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra kī la ya a ko ṭa la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ shar nas phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ me nas mtshams g.yas skor dang*/ steng 'og tu bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas phur bu zug /khro mo rnams kyis phyag g.yas kyi tho bas brdungs pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du son par phur bus btab pas/ bgegs thams cad bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor ro gcig tu gyur/

khwa gdong ma la sogs pas bgegs lhag ma rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas/ rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi ba la thim pas/ chu la chu brdabs bas zegs ma phyir mthor ba bzhin du/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pa las rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i ra ba zlum po gsum par mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje me g.yon skor du 'khyil zhing 'bar bas/ steng dang logs kun tu khyab bas 'gro ba thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad du bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar baṃ ser po las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar aṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin dbus sngo la mtha' skya ba/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi 'od zer gyis rang gi spyi bo nas rkang ba'i bar gang ste/ thog ma med pa nas kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma rnams sbyangs pas/ lus shel sgong bzhin du dag par gyur te/ ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ 'og min nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang lha dang lha mo dang khro bos nam mkha'i khams til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*/ /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/

shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ shrī he ru ka pā t+yaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ puṣ+be'i gnas su/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ n+ya we te/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ tāṃ ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dā+e pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū ba badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ par+she badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhar+m+mā dha tu badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bskal ba chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ o+oṃ ral ba'i cod pan mi bzad pa dang ldan hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i 'jigs pa'i zhal hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ stong phrag phyag ni 'bar ba'i 'od zer can hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dgra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa can hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ 'phags ma rig ma'i dbang phyug khams gsum gyis mi thub hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ 'byung bo'i 'jigs pa thams cad rdo rje chen pos 'joms hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rdo rje gdan bzhugs gzhan gyis mi thub dbang byed spyan hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gtum mo khro mo'i gzugs kyis tshangs pa skems pa dang hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bdud rnams skrag cing skyems pas gzhan gyi phyogs las rgyal hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ rmugs byed rengs byed rmongs byed kun las rnam par rgyal hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rdo rje phag mo sbyor chen 'dod dbang ma la 'dud hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ / byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/'grod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gi bdag nyid skad cig ma/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ zhes pa nas/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /mchod yul dang*/ mchod mkhan dang*/ mchod rdzas rnams rnam par rig pa'i sems kyis btags pa tsam du zad do/ /rang gi spyi bor he dkar bo/ / mgrin par ru dmar ba/ /snying gar ka mthing kha de gsum gyi don rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rgyu dang*/ brjod pa dang bral ba dang*/ gang du yang mi gnas pa nyid do/ /sems can rnams kyis chos rnams kyi yin tshul 'di lta bu ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams pas na/ bdag gis he ru ka'i go 'phang mngon du byas la/ gzung 'dzin bden pas stongs pa'i sems can rnams kyis yin tshul 'di rtogs par byas te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shung+nghaḥsarba dhar+m+maḥswa bhā wa shung+ngho3haṃ/ khams gsum po rang bzhin gyis grub pas stongs par gyur/ yi ge gsum po yongs su gyur pa las/ smon lam gyi dbang gis rang gi sems de steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i oṃ dkar bo/

āḥdamar bo/ hūm̐ sngon por gyur/ de gsum las rim pa bzhin du sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams spros te/ sa 'og dang mi yul dang mtho ris rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi ngo bor byas nas/ snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba oṃ dang gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba āḥdang thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams zhu ba hūm̐ la rim pa bzhin du thim zhing*/ oṃ yang āḥl/ āḥyang hūm̐ la rim pa bzhin du thim zhing*/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu u ni ha la/ ha ni ha'i mgo bo la/ de yang zla tshes la/ de yang thig le la/ de yang nā da la thim zhing*/ nā da yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha'i chod tsam du gnas par gyur/ sems can rnams kyis chos nyid ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pas/ bdag gis chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs par byas la rang bzhin gyis grub pas stongs pa'i sems can rnams kyis kyang chos nyid khong du chud par byas te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar bya'o/ /oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ de ltar snang ba thams cad bsdus pa'i stong ba nyis las rang gi sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du 'greng ba shin tu phra ba/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las/ yaṃ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po/ dbyibs gzhu lta bu/ g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ dmar bo yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar bo dbyibs gru gsum pa/ gru gsum du raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ dkar bo yongs su gyur pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dkar bo dbyibs zlum po dbus su bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ ser bo yongs su gyur pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor kha dog ser bo dbyibs gru bzhi ba/

grwa gzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab lhun po gru bzhi ba/ rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can steng gi phyogs mtshams su lcog brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ de'i steng du baṃ ser bo las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng gi lte bar baṃ las lte ba dang tshad mnyam pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar dang ldan pa/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar/ me rlung gnyis ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan nag/lte ba'i ljang*/ ge sar ser ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma chung ngu'i dbus su mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ zhes pa nas/ aṃ aḥste/ dbyangs dkar bo bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang*/ a ā/ zhes pa nas/ aṃ aḥste/ dbyangs dkar bo bcu drug pa phrag gcig g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de'i phyir rol tu dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ /ka kha nga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍa ḍha ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da da dha dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ya ra/ la la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa ste/ gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag cig g.yas skor dang*/ slar yang*/ ka kha zhes pa nas/ ha k+ṣa ste gsal byed dmar bo bzhi bcu ba phrag gcig g.yon skor du rim pa gcig gis 'khod/ de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can la dbyangs so gnyis dang*/ gsal byed brgyad cu gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du snang ba'i ā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i cha ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ kā li dang zla ba'i kha dog dmar ba'i cha ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ rang rig lte ba'i nā das zla ba dkar la dmar ba mthong ba na/ bdag gis sangs rgyas yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar gyi ngo bor gyur ba'i dbus su skye ba blangs la/ sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa dang ldan pas/ zla ba'i dbus su nā da zhugs pa las/

rim gyi nā da las thig le/ de las zla phyed/ de las ha'i mgo bo/ de las ha'i lus/ de las u grub pa'i tshul gyis/ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi hūṃ yig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin can du yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ hūṃ yig las kha dog sna lnga ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i rtse mo las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs rnams 'thon te/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs kyi go 'phang la bkod pa dang*/ sngon thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa rnams lhan cig spyan drangs te/ mnyam par sbyar ba mngon du 'gro bas zhu bar gyur te/ hūṃ yig gi nā da la thim zhing*/ hūṃ yig lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa ni bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wā k+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shung+ngha sarba dhar+m+maḥbadz+ra shung+ngho3haṃ/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ de yang khang ba brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi ba sgo bzhi ba/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar/ ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsig pas bskor ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar bo la/ rin po che zur gsum dang*/ gru bzhi la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su/ chu srin gyi kha nas mu tig gi do zhal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng na pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la gnas pa'i gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/

phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la/ bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang*/ rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar bo'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi ba'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rta babs gyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang bo las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba la sogs pa'i bsrung 'khor/ de'i phyi rol tu bskal ba 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu rdo rje'i me kha dog sna lnga bas/ steng dang logs kun tu khyab par g.yon skor du 'khyil zhing 'bar ba/ de'i phyi rol na gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag/byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu rdo rje 'bar ba/ lhor keng rus can/ dbang ldan du drag tu rgod pa/ mer bkra shis tshal/ bden bral du mun pa drag po/ rlung du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa ste/ ro mgo med dang*/ 'gags te shing la dpyangs pa dang*/ sa la 'gyel ba dang*/ gsal shing la bskyon pa dang*/ mdung gis phug pa dang*/ phyed tshig pa dang*/ mgo thod dang*/ byin pa'i rus pa dang*/ gtsigs pa'i mgo dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i rus pa 'thor ba dang*/ ma 'thor ba'i keng rus rnams gcal du bkram pa'i gnas su gyur pas dur khrod do/ /de na gnas pa'i shing brgyad ni/

shar du shir ṣa/ byang du a shwad tha/ nub tu kang ke la/ lhor tsu ta/ dbang ldan du ba tra/ mer ka rañdza/ bden bral du pa ṭa pa rka/ rlung du par thi ba rnams so/ /shing gi rtsa bar gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ shar du dbang bo ser bo rab brtan dkar bo la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang du nor sbyin ser bo mi la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas ne'u le rin po che skyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar bo gdengs ka bdun ldan chu srin la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du dbang phyug chen po dkar bo glang la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar bo rwa skyes la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas phreng ba spyi blugs dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ bde bral du srin po sngon po gcer bu mi mgo'i phreng ba'i cod pan can ro langs la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha dud kha sha ba la zhon pa/ g.yas 'og mas ba dan ser po 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yon 'og mas thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ shing brgyad kyi stod kyi yal ga'i gseb nas lus phyed 'thon pa'i zhing skyong brgyad ni/ shar du glang bo che'i gdong can dkar bo/ byang du mi'i gdong can ser bo/ nub tu chu srin gyi gdong can dkar bo/ lhor ma he'i gdong can nag po/ dbang ldan du glang gi gdong can dkar po/ mer rwa'i gdong can dmar po/ bden bral du ro langs kyi gdong can nag po/ rlung du ri dwags kyi gdong can ljang ku/ thams cad kyang drag cing gtum la rdzu 'phrul chen po ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gtor ma dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ thugs rje'i chu brgyad dang de la gnas pa'i klu brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas dkar bo/ byang du 'jog po dmar bo/

nub tu ka rkoṭa sngon po/ lhor pad+ma dkar bo/ dbang ldan du pad+ma chen po dkar bo/ mer mtha' yas sna tshogs mdog/bden bral du rigs ldan dkar bo/ rlung du dung skyong ser bo/ /thams cad kyang stod mi 'dra ba la smad sprul 'jug tu 'khyil zhing*/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gtso bo la 'dud pa/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad ni/ shar du sgrogs pa/ byang du cher sgrogs pa/ nub tu drag po/ lhor g.yo ba/ dbang ldan du brtan pa/ mer gang ba/ bden bral du 'bebs pa/ rlung du gtum po/ thams cad kyang klog phreng 'khyud cing 'brug sgra sgrogs pa 'ga' zhig char gyi rgyan can kha dog sna tshogs pa/ de na gnas pa'i ri brgyad ni/ shar du rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi lhun po/ byang du man dha ra ljang ku/ nub tu ke la sha dkar bo/ lhor ma la ya ser bo/ dbang ldan du dbang chen nag po/ mer spos dad ldang ser bo/ /bden bral du gangs can dkar bo/ rlung du dpal gyi ri sngon po'o/ /ri de rnams la gnas pa'i mchod rten dkar bo brgyad dang grub chen brgyad do/ /gzhan yang ye shes kyi me brgyad dang*/ khwa dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ ce sbyang dang*/ 'ol ba pho mo dang*/ sprul ba lang gi mgo can la sogs pa phyogs su rgyu zhing*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ ro langs dang*/ srin po rnams kyis ki li ki li'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa dang*/ grub pa thob pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ dam tshig sbyod ba'i rnal 'byor ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta ba/ gcer bu skra bshig pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ cang te'u dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ thod pas spyi bor brgyan pa/ rgod cing dur khrod du 'jug pa rnams kyis shin tu ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i dur khrod rnams kyi bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi steng 'og rnams shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/

dbus sngo ba/ 'og gzhi dam tshig gi 'khor lo la gnas pa'i sku'i 'khor lo dkar bo rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la 'khor lo'i phreng ba/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar bo rtsibs brgyad pa'i mu khyud la pad+ma'i phreng ba/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsigs brgyad pa'i mu khyud ya rdo rje'i phreng ba/ de'i lte bar bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba/ 'khor lo bzhi bo re re la mtshams rnams na gnas pa'i ka ba brgyad brgyad kyis bteg pa'i gdung zlum rim pa bzhi ba'i thog gi je mtho je mthor gyur ba'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi ba'i rtsa zhal nag/g.yon zhal ljang*/ rgyab zhal dmar/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ zhal re re yang spyan gsum pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ dpral bar rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi ba'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma g.yas ḍa ma ru dang g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa'i mgo bo mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo lag pa bzhi ba'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba lhag ma gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i nu ma mnan pa/ gdan gnyis ka'ang gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'i g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga ba dang g.yon pas dril bu bsnams pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang bo che'i pags pa dkar bo khrag dang bcas pa'i na bza' phyag g.yas pas lag pa g.yon pa dang g.yon pas rkang ba g.yon pa'i pags pa rang gi rgyab tu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas phyag gis brgyangs te 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyi rtse gnyis smin ma'i thad sor gnas pa/

g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi ba na dgra sta/ lnga ba na gri gug/ drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsgreng ba/ g.yon pa'i phyag gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/ bzhi ba na khrag gis gang pa'i thod pa/ lnga ba na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi ba bsnams shing*/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral ba'i thor cog can/ dbu re re rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba stod smad du gnas pa gnyis la brgyus pa'i thod pa bskam po lnga lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ dbu'i g.yon du cung zad g.yo ba'i zla ba phyed pa 'chang ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa ste sku'i nyams gsum dang*/ rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung ba ste gsung gi nyams gsum dang*/ snying rje dang rngams pa zhi ba ste thugs kyi nyams gsum ste/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa/ mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ /yab yum phan tshun du 'khyud pas ni/ thabs dang shes rab phan tshun du 'khyud pa mtshon zhing de yang yum dang sbyor ba sogs kyi lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs khyad par can las/ mgo bo nas byang sems kyi zla ba zhu ba dang*/ des lus kun la khyab pa las byung ba'i thabs bde ba chen pos shes rab stong ba nyid rnam thar bzhi'i don bsgom dgos par mtshon de'i bde ba ni kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod bas mtshon pa'i don dang*/ de gnyis kyang rdo rje dang dril bus mtshon pa'i ye shes lnga dang*/ sher phyin don dang ā li dang kā li'i thabs shes so/ /de'i byed las ni chags sogs sbyong ba dang*/ gti mug bral ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskul zhing sgo gsum gyi skyon dang mthar 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gcod pa dang*/ nyon mongs ba rnams 'bigs shing yang dag pa'i ye shes kyis 'ching ba dang*/

rtag pa 'khor ba'i yod mtha' dang*/ chad pa myang 'das kyi med mtha' gnyis gnon zhing stong nyid rtogs pas 'gro ba kun zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /de ltar mdzad pa'i 'bras bu la skyon zad pa'i spangs pa ni tshangs mgo dang*/ zhi mtha' spangs pa'i 'od gsal las gzugs skur bzhengs pa ni thod bskam dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs ba ni phyag gnyis dang*/ log lta kun las log pa'i zhal 'gyur ba dang*/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa dang*/ yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rtogs pa ni ral ba gyen du bsdus pa dang*/ de mthar phyin nas ye shes lngar gnas pa ni rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ ye shes des ji snyed pa thams cad gzigs pa ni spyan gsum dang*/ 'phrin las bzhis sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa ni sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ phyin drug gi lam thams cad rdzogs par mdzad pa ni/ phyag rgya drug gis mtshon pa'i don dang*/ gshegs pa lnga dang gshegs ma bzhis bsdus pa'i zhi lhag gi nyams thams cad dang ldan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ /zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ thod pa'i dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og bag can/ phyag g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa'i thod pa na/ bdud bzhi la sogs pa'i khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ g.yas pas phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can la rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ 'gro ba stong ba nyid du mnyam par rtogs pas bskal ba 'jig pa'i dus gyi me lta bu/ shin tu dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba dang ldan pas/ nyi ma'i 'od can gyi gzi brjid che ba/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla'i steng du legs par 'khril ba/ lhag mthong gi rang bzhin gyi bde ba chen por gnas kyang*/

'gro ba'i don byed pas thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo bskam po lnga'i thod dang*/ mi mgo bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ dkar bo las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar bo rtse lnga ba/ byā dmar bo las byung ba'i nor bu dmar bo rtse mo la byā ser bos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ a dmar bo las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar bo 'dab ma gsum pa d+yā dkar po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i lte ba dkar bo/ rtse mor d+yā ser bos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte bar zla gdan la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ thugs kar zla gdan la/ oṃ sarba bung+ngha ḍā kī nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye huṃ huṃ phaṭa swāhā/ mgrin par nyi gdan la oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dz+wa la shaṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ dpral bar nyi gdan la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar nyi gdan la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra=/ thugs kar nyi gdan la/ oṃ hrīḥ=/ mgrin par zla gdan la/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro=/ dpral bar zla gdan la/ oṃ sarba bung+ngha=/ sngags thams cad kha dog dmar bo 'od zer 'phro ba/ g.yon skor du gnas pa/ sngags rnams kyang phan tshun du zhal sbyor zhing 'od zer 'khyud pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin par sleb pa na dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas snying gar sleb pa na mchog dga'/ snying ga nas lte bar sleb pa na khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lte ba nas nor bu'i rtser sleb pa na lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pas rten dang brten ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyang bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor gyur/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang ku/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig ma/

spyan gsum ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i zhal can/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa bzung nas thugs kar 'khyud pa'i tshul mdzad cing*/ g.yas 'og mas ḍa ma ru dang*/ g.yon 'og mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ cung zad bzhad pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod bskam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ mtshams bzhir zla gdan la bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi ste/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pul+li ra/ ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab gtum ma/ byang rtsibs dzā lan+dha ra ma hā kaṅga la dang gtum mig ma/ nub rtsibs o ḍi la ṇa ra kaṅka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me rtsibs gau dā ba ri ra su ra bai ri ṇā dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ bden bral gyi rtsibs ra me shwa ri ra 'od dpag med dang larba ri rlung rtsibs de waṃ ko ṭi ra rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams nam mkha' spyod ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma rū bar myu gu can dngas srung ma/ byang rtsibs o ṭer rdo rje ral ba can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ me rtsibs ka liṅkar rab tu bzang bo dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ bden bral gyi rtsibs laṃ kar rdo rje bzang bo dang shin tu bzang mo/ rlung rtsibs kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs hi mā la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/

thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar bo/ sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs bre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri ha de btar rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ nub rtsibs sau rāṣ+tarar rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ lho rtsibs su wa r+ṇa drī bar nam mkha'i snying bo dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ me rtsibs nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpal mo/ /bden bral gyi rtsibs sin dhūr pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rlung rtsibs ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar bo ste/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi bo thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ sbyan gsum pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs can/ dpa' bo'i dar thod dpral bar bcings pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis rdor dril bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas ḍa ma ru dang*/ g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dpa' mo nyer bzhi bo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma/ yab la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas gdug pa can kun la bsdigs pa'i sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang pa'i thod pa 'dzin cing stob pa/ drag mo'i gzugs can gcer mo skra grol bas rnam par mdzes shad/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod pa bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod bskam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'og bag sil sil gyi sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ /lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/

lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo chen mos sems can kun gyi don mdzad pa la brtson pa/ zhal gcig ma/ spyan gsum ma/ mche ba rnams par gtsigs pa'i zhal can/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang bos gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang bos thod pa bzung nas thugs kar 'khyud pa'i tshul mdzad cing*/ g.yas 'og mas ḍa ma ru dang*/ g.yon 'og mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis zhugs pa/ phyag rgya lnga'i brgyan pa/ thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod bskam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyang dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems zhu ba/ spyi bo nas mgrin par/ zhes pa nas/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pas/ bde stong dbyer med du sbyar ba de nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun gyi ngo bor gyur pa lha so bdun du shar ba ni/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ chos rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ lā ma dang*/ dum skyes ma dang*/ gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba dang*/ spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba dang*/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ rab gtum ma dang*/ gtum mig ma dang*/ 'od ldan ma dang*/ sna chen ma'o/ / dad pa'i dbang bo dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang bo dang*/ dran pa'i dbang bo dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bo bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ dpa' bo'i blo can ma dang*/

mi'u thung ma dang*/ laṅka'i dbang phyug ma dang*/ shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab gyi dbang bo dang*/ dad pa'i stobs dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang*/ dran pa'i stobs bzhi ni rim pa bzhin sa srung ma dang*/ 'dzin byed chen mo dang*/ rlung gi shugs can ma dang*/ chang 'thung ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang*/ shes rab gyi stobs dang*/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ sngo bsangs lha mo dang*/ shin tu bzang mo dang*/ rta rna ma dang*/ bya gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ chos rab tu rnams 'byed yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang*/ dum skyes ma dang*/ chang 'tshong ma dang*/ 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i ngag bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ /shin tu dpa' mo dang*/ stobs chen ma dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ma dang*/ brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang*/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i dran pa bzhi ni rim pa bzhin/ khwa gdong ma dang*/ 'ug gdong ma dang*/ khyi gdong ma dang*/ phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ skyes pa rnams bsrung ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong pa dang*/ ma skyes ba rnams mi bskyed pa'i yang dag sbong bzhi ni rim kha bzhin/ gshin rje brtan ma dang*/ gshin rje bo nya mo dang*/ gshin rje mche ba ma dang*/ gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /rkang ba gnyis bgrad pa gzhu'i dbyibs su yod pa yongs su gyur ba las/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can dang*/

sum mdo gru gsum gyi gzugs su yod pa yongs su gyur pa las me dkyil zur gsum dang*/ lto ba zlum po'i dbyibs can yongs su gyur ba las chu dkyil zlum po dang*/ snying ga gru bzhi ba yongs su gyur pa las sa dkyil gru bzhi dang*/ sgal tshigs yongs su gyur pa las ri rab/ spyi bo'i rtsa so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma/ lus 'dom gang yan man dang phan tshun du mnyam pa yongs su gyur pa las ngos bzhi mnyam pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ pha gu dang dra phyed sogs kyi rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes pa'i dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor/ rkang brgyad las ka ba brgyad/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum las 'khor lo gsum/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi dhū tī'i nang gi byang sems ba mo lta bu 'dzag pa/ nyungs kar sbom po'i tshad kyi dpyid hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi ba'i rtsa zhal nag/ ces pa nas/ mi rus kyi thal bas lus thams cad la byugs pa'o/ /lte ba'i dmar cha gtum mo'i me'i gzugs kyi thigs le yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ /zhes pa nas/ sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ bskal ba 'jigs pa'i dus kyi me lta bu/ nyi ma'i 'od can gyi gzi brjid che ba/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis/ yab kyi brla'i steng du legs par 'khril ba/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo bskam po lnga'i thod dang*/ mi mgo bskam bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ dpyid dang thig le'i ngo bo gnyis snying gar phrad nas snyoms par 'jug pas/ snying ga'i shar la sogs pa'i 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa 'dab bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ zhes pa nas/ thod bskam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ shar lho la sogs pa'i mchod pa bzhi'i rtsa 'dab bzhi yongs su gyur ba las/

mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi ste bde chen gyi 'khor lo'o/ /spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir/ pū/ dzā/ o/ a/ go rā/ de/ mā/ kā o/ tri/ ko ka la/ kā hi/ pre/ gri sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ gu rnams thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsibs khong stong rtsibs shun gyi rnam pa dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo nyer bzhi'i rnam pa can phyi'i yul nyer bzhi'i ngo bor gyur/ gnas nyer bzhi'i rtsa dang khams ngo bo dbyer med du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo nyer bzhir gyur pa ni/ skra mtshams pul+li ra ma la yar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams yongs su gyur pa las/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rtsa yongs su gyur pa las rab gtum ma/ spyi gtsug dzā lan+dha rar gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ ma hā kaṅka ma dang gtum mig ma/ rna ba g.yas pa oṭ+ṭi ya ṇa ra= kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbu tar= mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ rna ba g.yon pa gau dā ba rir= su ra bai ri ṇa dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ smin mtshams ra me shwa rir= 'od dpag med dang kha rba ri/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭir= rdo rje'i 'od dang lad+ga'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis mā la war= rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ nye ba'i gnas te thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis=/ mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū par= myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ /nu ma gnyis o ṭer= rdo rje ral ba can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste shing ngo*/ /lte ba tri sha ku ner= dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma dang*/ sna rtse ko sa lar= rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo*/ kha ka liṅka= rab tu bzang bo dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ /mgrin pa laṃ pa kar= rdo rje bzang bo dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshan+da ho'o/ /snying kañtsir= 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'bras bu gnyis hi ma la yar=

mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste nye ba'i tshan+do ha ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams sa la spyod= mtshan ma pre ta bu rir= stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gri ha de ba tar= rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma ste 'dus pa'o/ /brla gnyis sau rāṣ+tar= rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ byin pa gnyis su war+ṇa dī bar= nam mkha'i snying bo dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'dus pa'o/ /sor mo bcu drug nā ga rar= dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpal mo/ bol gong gnyis sin dhūr= pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do/ /mthe bong bzhi ma rur= rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tār gnas pa'i rtsa nang gi khams dang rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod de/ sku'i 'khar le'i lha rnams sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi bo thams cad kyang*/ zhes pa nas/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dpa' mo nyer bzhi bo thams cad kyang*/ zhes pa nas/ 'og pag sil sil gyi sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /lce'i rtsa bar gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las khwa gdong ma nag mo/ lte ba'i bug gar gnas pa'i= 'ug gdong ma ljang ku/ rtags kyi sgor gnas pa'i= khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ bshang lam gyi sgor= phag gdong ma ser mo/ mdzod spu'i bu gar= gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ rna ba gnyis na= gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ mig gnyis na= gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ sna bug gnyis na gnas pa'i rtsa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo chen mo/ zhes pa nas/ 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyang dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ rang gi snying gar oṃ ha dkar bo yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar bo dkar dmar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje ḍa ma ru mgo bo/

g.yon dril bu thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mgo bor na ga nyi ser bo yongs su gyur ba las/ rnam snang ser bo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'dzin pa gshin rje ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar bo= pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar bo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis= rmongs byed ma dang = phrag pa gnyis la bau ṣaṭa he nag po= dpal he ru ka nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis= skyod byed ma dang = mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser= rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis= skrag byed ma dang= dpral bar yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang ku yongs su gyur ba las/ rta mchog ljang ku zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rdor sems zla gdan la bzhugs shing*/ zla ba'i 'od kor can/ gzhan lnga ni nyi gdan la bzhugs shing nyi ma'i 'od kor can/ dpa' bo drug po thams cad kyang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ thod bskams lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ spyan gsum pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar bo yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo dmar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gri gug/tshangs mgo/ lcags kyu/ g.yon thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rdor sems dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po= gshin rje ma sngon mo rnam snang dang = mgrin par hriṃ moṃ dkar bo= rmongs byed ma dkar mo pad+ma gar dbang dang =

mgo bor hreṃ hriṃ ser po= skyod byed ma ser mo dpal he ru ka dang spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang ku= skrag byed ma ljang ku rdo rje nyi ma dang= dpral bar yan lag thams cad kyi lus dbang gi ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha yongs su gyur pa las/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha rta mchog dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpa' mo lnga bo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug/g.yon gnyis thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rmongs byed ma zla gdan la bzhugs shing zla ba'i 'od kor can/ gzhan lnga nyi gdan la bzhugs shing nyi ma'i 'od kor can/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod bskam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ bsdu na/ go cha bsdus pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas/ pheṃ rang dang lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma ye shes pa'i 'khor lor gyur pa dang*/ dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor ba rnams dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying gar thim/ dbang gi lha mo rnams ni ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ oṃ dhar+m+ma dhā tu badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghan+ṭa hoḥ oṃ yo ga shung+ngha sarba dhar+m+maḥyo ga shung+ngho3haṃ/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis ro mnyam du sbyar ba ni/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid dang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis ngo bo dbyer med yin la/ de nyid rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba yin cing*/ de yang gtso bo yab yum du shar ba'i cha shas so/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swabha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

oṃ badz+ra shung+ngha sarba dhar+m+maḥbadz+ra shung+ngho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ oṃ dhar+m+ma dhā tu badz+rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi phag mo dang lngas phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa cung zad yo bar byas te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ rang dang lha rnams bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur/ spyi bo nas sku la zhugs pa'i chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ phag mo la rnam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi la rin 'byung*/ thugs 'khor gyi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor gyi lha rnams la snang mtha'/ sku 'khor gyi lha rnams la rnam snang*/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ des bum pa'i dbang thob/ de nas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi phag mo la thim/ de dang he ru ka snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems lce la bzhag pa myang ba las gsang ba'i dbang thob/ de nas he ru kas phag mo phyag rgyar gnang ba la snyoms par zhugs pas rlung thim pa las/ lhan skyes kyi bde ba myong ba las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ de nas he ru kas rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis phyag rgya dang sbyar ba la brten nas thob pa'i snang ba thob pa'i ye shes de/ 'od gsal bar sgoms shig /'od gsal de ni snang mched thob gsum gyi rnam shes rnam par dag pa shes phyin gyi ngo bo yin la/

don dam pa'i bden pa de ni mthong ba gzhan gyi yul las 'das pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes gyi mig gis ltos shig/de ltar gzhan gang gi yang rang bzhin du ma mthong ba de 'od gsal mthong ba yin no/ /de'i ngo na rgyu 'bras gang yang med mod kyi/ 'on kyang kun rdzob tu rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i lta so bdun gzugs brnyan ltar gsal la rdzogs pa/ 'ja' tshon ltar kha dog ma 'dres bar so sor snang ba/ chu zla ltar sgro skur dang bral bar ltos shig/de 'dra ba'i kun rdzob dang don dam 'od gsal gnyis dbyer mi phyed par zung du 'jug pa ni byang chub kyi sems chen po ste/ dbang bzhi ba'o/ /zhes don gyi dbang bzhi pa bstan pa'i don go ba las/ tshig gi sgo nas dbang bzhi ba thob/ dbang gi las rnams rang la thim par gyur/

de nas mchod pa byin brlab bya ba ni/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa/ zhes pa nas/ kaṃ las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin stong nyid/ ces pa nas/ ster bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pā h+yaṃ=/ oṃ añtsa ma ṇaṃ=/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ=/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra sbar+she āḥhūṃ/ de nas/ oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ sbar+she pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod nas/ chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang 'dod yon lnga rnams 'bul/ de nas rig ma bcu drug gis mchod nas/ mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūṃ dkar bo las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar bo nas 'bru tsam 'khod/ oṃ a mri ta ud ka hūṃ hūṃ ṭha ṭha traṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha mo ro rdo rje mas bdud rtsi bstabs pa rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ/ mchod do/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi mnga' bdag/drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal sras phyag na rdo rje'i=/ dpal ldan sa ra ha ba'i=/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi=/ dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug gi=/ grub chen lū i pa'i=/ rgyal bo dha ri ka ba'i=/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu ba'i=/ grub chen rus sbal zhabs kyi=/ grub chen dza lan+dha ra ba'i=/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'-i=/ grub chen rnam rgyal zhabs ky-i=/ grub chen te lo ba'-i=/ paṇa chen nā ro ba'-i=/ pham thing ba sku mched ky-i=/ glog skya shes rab brtsegs ky-i=/

mal lo ts+tsha ba blo gros grags ky-i=/ sa chen kun dga' snying bo'i=/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'-i=/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gy-i=/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'-i=/ rgyal sras bsod nams sed+ge'-i=/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum gy-i=/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros ky-i=/ bla ma dpal ldan sed+ge'-i=/ bu ston rin chen grub ky-i=/ khyung bo lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams kyi/ chos kyi rgyal bo rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi=/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge legs dpal bzang gi=/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi=/ rje btsun chos kyi rdo rje'i=/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub kyi=/ rdo rje 'chang chen sangs rgyas ye shes gyi=/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i=/ pad dkar 'dzin pa thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtsho'i=/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba budha ḍā kī nī ye badz+ra warna nī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ ḍā kī nī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ces pa nas/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos thos pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la brten pa/ bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ klu la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/

oṃ a mri ta swa da na swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mgron thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis tshim par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las byung ba'i snying bo'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis thod pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba badz+ra kā mi ni sarba bhak+ṣaṃ sho dha ya gu h+ya badz+ra ṇi swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gnas bzhi dang gsang gnas/ ces pa nas/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pas/ lha thams cad kyis kyang*/ bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams lhan skyes kyi bde ba dang de kho na nyid dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la shaṃ ba raṃ swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nā ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sar+b+ba bung+ngha ḍā kī nī ye badz+ra warna ni ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ru bi ṇi ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ra ka ra huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsan+ṭi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan+ṭi ak+ṣi ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bhā ba ti ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma tāṃ ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba ri ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhuṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dru ma ts+tsha ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e rā ba tī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhai ra wi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ pā yu be ge huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba laṃ pi ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su rā bhak+ṣi ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarba bā tardza ya tardza ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+ya mā de wī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kaḍ+ḍha a kaḍ+ḍha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha tri huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzā+auṃ dzā+auṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha gā na ne huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ haṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇ+ḍi ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra bar+m+mi ṇī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra brti ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bīr+ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā ka s+ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lū kā s+ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā s+ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shū kā rā s+ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā ḍhī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū t+ṣi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā ṣ+ti ṇaṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣ+ti ṇaṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bhi ga ba te wi re shā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bhā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzaṭā ma ku ṭo t+k+ra ṭā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+tā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭa ga dha ri ṇi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bya gra dzī nā m+bar dha rā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhu m+b+rā n+ta kā ra wa pū ṣā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a ba rā dzi ta trai lo kya mā te bī d+ya shwa rī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhū ta bha ye ba he ma hā badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+rā san a ba ra dzī ta ba sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bh+ra ma ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro nghe ka rā le ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo trā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da nī ba rā dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa sngags kyi mchod pa'o/ /oṃ kar kar huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nas/ oṃ dhi li dhi li huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ so dang sen mo bskyaid pa sogs lus kyi khams nyer bzhi dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa la trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba laṃ bi ni/ grih+na grih+ṇa/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ /sarbaṃ pā/ ta rdza ya ta rdza ya/ a kaḍ+ḍha a kaḍ+ḍha/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ/ haṃ haṃ/ hīṃ hiṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ*/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ oṃ ha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma hi huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swā hā hu huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bau ṣa ṭa he huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa haṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ de rnams las byung ba'i phyag rgya drug dang*/ nye ba'i phyag rgya rnams so/ ༈ /oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī/ pro tad+ge pro tad+ge ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ kiṃ ki ṇi/ khiṃ khi ṇi/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra khaṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dha ri ṇi/ ma hā bi shi ta māṃ sā sa ni/

ma nu ṣān+t+ra pra bre te sa ni dh+ya na ra si ra mā la grāṃ thi ta dha ra ṇi/ sum+bha ni sum+bha ha na ha na pra ṇaṃ/ sarba pa sha pā nāṃ/ ma hā man sa ts+tshe da ni/ kro dha murte daṃṣ+t+wa ka rā li ni ma hā mu tre/ shri he ru ka d+ye s+ye/ gra ma hi ṣī sa ha sra shrī re/ sa ha sra bā ha be/ sha ta sa ha sra na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa lā mu khe saṃ ga la lo tsa ne/ badz+ra shwa rī re badz+ra sa ni/ mi li ta tsi li ta/ he he/ hūṃ hūṃ/ kha kha/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ a dwe te/ ma hā yo gi nī/ pa ṭhi ta sing+nghe/ treṃ dhaṃ treṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ he he/ ha ha/ bhi me ha sa ha sa bī re/ hā hā/ he he/ hūṃ hū/ trai lo kya bi nā sha ni sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri wa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ siṃ ha ru pe khaḥg dza rū pe āḥ trai lo kya u dha re sa mu tra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bī rā dwe te hūṃ hūṃ/ ha ha ma hā pa shu mo hā ni yo gi shwa ri twaṃ/ ḍā ki nī sar+b+ba lo kā nāṃ ban+na nī sa d+ya pra d+ya ya ka re ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bhu ta trā sa nī ma hā bī ra pa ra ma sing+ngha yo gi shwa ri phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de las byung ba'i mgul rgyan dang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍa ki nī dzā la shaṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ de las byung ba'i thod pa'i do shal dang*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de las byung ba'i rna rgyan dang*/ oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā kī nī ye badz+ra warna ni ye huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ de las byung ba'i glang lpags dang*/ oṃ oṃ baṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ yoṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ moṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hreṃ hriṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de las byung ba'i ska rags dang*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ pra tsan+ṭi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan+ṭi ak+ṣi ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bhā ba ti ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma tī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba ri ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ laṅke shwa ri ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dru mats+tsha ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e rā ba tī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhai ra wī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su rā bhak+ṣi ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+yā ma de wīṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha hre huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha gā na ne huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇ+ḍi ni huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra war+m+mi ṇī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti nī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pīr+ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā ka s+ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ u lū kā s+ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā s+ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shū kā rā s+ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā ḍhī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū tī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣ+t+ri ṇi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de las byung ba'i thod pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nā ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de las byung ba'i thod bskam gyi dbu rgyan rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ /shes rab ḍa ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul ba ste/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul ba ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ he ni rgyu sogs stong ba yin/ /ru ni bkod dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /a ā/ zhes pa nas/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ dbyangs gsal gyi phreng ba 'od zer lnga ldan 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs 'phro ba/

sna bug g.yas pa'i rlung dang 'grogs nas 'phros pas/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs su byas/ /byas pa de rnams thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams dang ro mnyam du gyur te/ sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te/ lte bar gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbyangs gsal gyi gzugs brnyan dang ldan pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du gyur/ de'i dbus su skad cig gis hūṃ yig dkar dmar de dang zla ba gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka dkar bo g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pas/ gsang gnas gnyis bskyod pa'i sgyu ma'i dga' ba'i sgras/ 'gro ba rnams bkug ste dur khrod la thim/ de rten gyi 'khor lo la thim/ rten gyi 'khor lo sgo mtshan ma brgyad dang bcas pa sku 'khor la thim/ de gsung 'khor la thim/ de thugs 'khor la thim/ de'i shar nas g.yon bskor gyi phyogs na gnas pa bzhi ni rim pa bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma nas bzung ste/ g.yon skor gyis lha mo bzhi la thim/ me nas brtsam te mtshams na gnas pa bzhi ni gzugs can ma nas bzung ste g.yos skor gyis lha mo bzhi la thim/ thod pa bzhi yang gzugs can ma la sogs pa bzhi la thim/ lha mo bzhi yang rang ngos kyi gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la thim par gyur/ dam tshig pa yab yum lte ba'i ye shes sems dpa' yab yum la thim/ de gnyis kyang snyoms par zhugs pas zhu bar gyur/ zhu ba de yongs su gyur pa las sin dhū ras byugs pa'i mu tig lta bu'i hūṃ yig bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūṃ gi zhags kyu u ni ha la/ ha ni ha'i mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim zhing*/ nā da yang skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha'i tshad tsam du gnas par gyur/

nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āh+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shung+ngha sar+b+ba ngharmāḥbadz+ra shung+ngho3haṃ/ stong ba'i ngang las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad skad cig gis gsal la yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ dkar dmar/ lha gzhan rang rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig la bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i dbus kyi yi ge las/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs 'phros nas 'gro ba'i don byas/ slar 'dus te dbus gyi yi ge la thim pa'i spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pa can du gyur/

phreng ba/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ phreng ba stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las/ phreng ba'i bskyed chog/sngon mthung mi legs pas 'di ltar bya ste/ skad cig gis gsung rdo rje pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ spyan gsum pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ pad+ma nir ti shwa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gsung rdo rje zhu ba las byung ba'i phreng ba'i rnam par gyur/ skabs 'dir bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzla tshul la mi 'dra mang du snang ba las/ lugs gcig ni/ thog mar yab kyi rtsa sngags/ snying bo/ nye snying*/ go cha'i sngags/ de nas yum gyi rtsa sngags/ snying bo/ nye snying*/ go cha'i sngags rnams bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ snying bo'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo gsum dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags rnams bzla ba dang*/ lugs gcig la ni/ yab yum so so'i snying bo nye snying rtsa sngags go cha'i sngags kyi mthar sngar ltar dang*/ yang rtsa sngags dang go cha'i sngags rnams mjug tu bzla ba'i lugs gcig ste/ gang byas kyang mi 'gal yang re zhig dang po ltar dang*/ sngags bsdus pa ni logs su shes par bya'o/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul na/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ pheṃ/ rang gi thugs gar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

oṃ shrī he ru ka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nas oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ swāhā/ lag pa gnyis a ā/ zhes pa nas/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dbus su hūṃ yig/oṃ a n+yo n+ya/ a nu ga ta sarba dhar+m+maḥpa ra s+pha ra/ a nu pra biṣ+ta sar+b+ba nghar+m+maḥ a t+yan+ta/ a nu bra biṣ+ta sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zla nyi hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur ba las/ rdo rje'i thal mor gyur/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /de brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/mchod pa'i 'khor gsum po rnams bde stong dbyer med du gyur/ mgron rnams kyi ljangs la hūṃ dkar bo las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar bo nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i rdo rje 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki n+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ tri sh+ya hoḥ lan gsum brjod nas/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang mkha' 'gro la bzhi ste/ gsum la 'bul/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ zhes pa nas/ dhi li dhi li huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ lan gcig gis 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a ra li hoḥ zhes pa nas/ tri sh+ya hoḥ lan gnyis kyis sgo mtshams brgyad la 'bul/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ srid pa dang mnyam zhi ba chags bcom kun tu rtogs pa 'joms/ khyod ni dngos po mtha' dag mkha' ltar gzigs pa dang ldan pa/ /mgon po shin tu brtse ba lci ba'i chus brlan thugs kyi chus/ / mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzod/ /dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong la sogs pa thams cad skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las/ bde mchog gi lha yab yum gyi skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags la hūṃ dkar bo las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar bo nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/

oṃ kha kha/ zhes pa nas/ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar lan gnyis/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swāhā/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ dril bu dkrol ba'i sgo nas/ yig brgya bzlas/ oṃ yo ga shung+nghaḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥyo ga shung+ngho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ'ajig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs zhing dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ / zhes sogs kyi smon lam de 'dir brjod dam min yang rung ngo*/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma mi 'bul bar skabs gzhan du 'bul na/ bzlas pa'i 'jug nas 'tshams 'dir 'jug/ lte ba'i ye shes sems dpa' yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ gsang gnas gnyis bskyod pa'i sgyu ma'i dga' ba'i sgras/ 'gro ba rnams bkug ste dur khrod la thim/ zhes pa nas/ lha mo bzhi yang rang ngos kyi gtso bo'i zhal bzhi thim par gyur/ lus dkyil gyi sgo mtshams brgyad dang bcas pa sku 'khor la thim de gsung 'khor la thim/ de thugs 'khor la thim/ de rnams kyang snying bo'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi thod pa dang bcas pa la thim/ de brgyad kyang nang gi he ru ka yab yum la thim/ de gnyis kyang snying gar thim pas/ rtsa dang khams thams cad byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ dam tshigs pa yab yum lte ba'i ye shes sems dpa' yab yum la thim/ de gnyis/ zha ེ sa pa nas/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid he ru ka sngon bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin ba g.yas brkyang gi bzhugs pa la/ lus rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla gdan la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar bo/ mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar po/

phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo/ bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo/ hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar se/ dpral bar nyi ma la rta mchog gi ngo bo/ phaṭa haṃ ljang ku/ gtso mo'i lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo/ /oṃ baṃ dmar bo/ snying gar nyi ma la gshin rje ma'i ngo bo/ haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo/ /hriṃ moṃ dkar bo/ mgo bor nyi ma la skyod byed ma'i ngo bo/ hriṃ hriṃ ser bo/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo/ hūṃ hūṃ ljang ku/ dpral bar nyi ma la tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir nyi gdan la/ pū/ dzā/ o/ a/ go rā/ de/ mā/ kā o/ tri/ ko ka la/ kā hi/ pri/ kri sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ ku rnams thig les brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ grih+ṇā pa ya huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni/ sogs smon lam gdab par bya'o// //lū hi i ba'i mngon rtogs la 'don cha cung mi 'dra ba 'ga' re snang yang*/ 'dir phyag len 'ga' zhig ni gzhan du shes par bya ba'i dbang du btang ste/ 'dzin 'don la 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i gnas brtan blo bzang brtson 'grus zhes bgyi bas dad pas 'di nyid par du brko ba'i tshe/ bshad sgrub ming can gyis rtag brtan gyi par ma dang bstun nas co ne dgon nyid kyi 'don cha ltar bsgrigs nas bkod pa'o// //maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/hi pa'i lugs kyi bde mchog gi mngon rtogs bzhugs/ - PAGE 30-- PAGE 29-- PAGE 9-
